question: Whether the theoretical link between calibration and selective risk holds under distribution shift.
description: The idea proposes a theoretical link between calibration and expected selective risk, but this link may assume i.i.d. data and may break under distribution shift between validation and test.
rationale: If the theoretical link does not hold under shift, the expected benefits may not materialize in practice.
resolution: The assumption that large-model accuracy is invariant to routing may not hold in other domains, indicating the theoretical link between calibration and selective risk could fail under distribution shift.
